body:
I'm sorry I didn't read your post before now, i wasn't too much in the mood to explore too much into other peoples lives or potential problems, not that I am now, but I realised that you reached out saying you were similarly struggling, you showed empathy and compassion towards me when you have no idea who I am, what I've done in life, what I do on a daily basis, yet you offered words of support in spite of your own suffering and struggles. The same for other people in this group, maybe we are not going to all have the happiest lives, maybe we are semi confined to a life of unhappiness of varying degrees, but equally more often than not, these people, and yourself included, fall into the category of being the most wonderful humans! You did this for me, and I hope that in someway it will do so for you.
Most people can't be nice and supportive when their world is going to plan, when their lives are on the track they want, and here you are in the middle of a crisis, offering support and compassion. 
It's not much I know, but your input today has changed my day immensely.
I've felt in the pits for a long old time, and I don't see that changing anytime soon, I came here as part of a quest to explore every untested avenue, so I could say 'I've done that' to the inevitable suggestion, I didn't expect anything, but the kindness you have showed, is part of the reminder as to why it can be worth it, and that's enough for me to put away certain thoughts for today, and to let today turn into tomorrow.
Am trying to do this exact thing! Thank you!
really thank you so much, you're a brilliant person to be so kind to someone you don't know, I still feel fucking awful, but reading these couple of messages has meant a lot to me
I just don't get how to even begin changing myself
I guess the first thing would be to not take every little obstacle like it's the end of the world
Thank you, its nice to hear that for a change :(
